properties.name: easy-extension.allow-unknown-business
properties.description: 是否允许未知业务，当没有业务身份可以匹配时，如果不允许未知业务则请求报错，如果允许，则扩展点会走默认能力兜底 whether to allow unknown business. when there is no business to match, if not allowed, the request will report an error. If allowed, the extension point will use the default ability.

properties.name: easy-extension.enable-session-auto-cleanup
properties.description: 是否注册兜底清理过滤器:请求结束时清空线程上残留的绑定 whether to register the fallback filter that clears leftover thread bindings after each request

properties.name: easy-extension.business-match-order
properties.description: 业务匹配优先级顺序（使用业务 code）。当多个业务同时匹配时，按此顺序选择优先级最高的。未列出的按注册顺序排在末尾。

properties.name: easy-extension.matcher-param-type
properties.description: 显式指定 Matcher 参数类型,覆盖从 Provider 泛型的推导 explicit matcher parameter type, overriding inference from providers' Matcher<T> generics

properties.name: easy-extension.session-exclude-path-patterns
properties.description: 不绑定业务身份的请求路径(Ant 风格),例如健康检查 request path patterns (Ant style) that never get a business bound, e.g. health checks
